question: According to Hinduism, which deity symbolises as the preserver and protector of the world?
solution:
The correct answer is __**God Vishnu.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to **Hinduism,** the deity symbolising as the **preserver and protector **of the world is **God Vishnu.**
 
• God Vishnu is considered one of the three main deities in Hinduism, along with** Brahma and Shiva.**
 
• Vishnu is often depicted with **blue skin and four arms**, and he holds various objects that represent his **powers and attributes.**
 
• Vishnu is believed to have taken **several incarnations** (avatars) to protect the world and restore balance, including the popular ones like** Rama and Krishna.**
 
• Vishnu is also associated with the concept of dharma, which refers to **righteousness, duty, and moral law.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **God Shiva** is another important deity in Hinduism, but he is usually associated with the role of** destroyer or transforme**r rather than preserver.

 
 
• Shiva is often depicted with a **third eye**, a **crescent moon **on his forehead, and a** snake** around his neck.
 
 
 
• **Goddess Sarasvati **is the Hindu goddess of **knowledge, music, and arts.**
 
 
• She is often depicted with a **veena **(musical instrument) and a **book or scroll.**
 
 
 
• **Goddess Lakshmi i**s the Hindu goddess of **wealth, prosperity, and fortune.**
 
 
• She is often depicted with **gold coins, lotus flowers, and an owl. **
